findings.issue: 'RB Leipzig – Borussia Mönchengladbach' hard-wraps mid-word with no hyphen: '...Mönchengladbac' on one line and a lone 'h' alone on the next line. All info is still present (nothing hidden/truncated), just an unpolished orphan-character break on this long compound word at this column width. Confirmed by scrolling directly to the row and re-screenshotting at higher effective resolution.

notes: Correctness checklist: all match names read in full at every width (long titles wrap onto 2-4 lines rather than truncate, e.g. 'Husqvarna British Masters hosted by Sir Nick Faldo', '1. FC Köln – TSG Hoffenheim', 'Union Berlin – Eintracht Frankfurt') - no hidden info anywhere, including the Bundesliga/Premier League/La Liga blocks.

Every agenda row and every 'DIREKTE NÅ' live item shows a channel, and every one seen is Norwegian or Norwegian-available: HBO Max (Sport), Discovery+ (+1), BLAST Premier (Twitch), Viaplay, TV 2 Play - no ESPN/FOX/Sky anywhere.

Team crests and country/tour flags render as distinct small graphics at all three widths - no broken-image icons or empty boxes (checked RB Leipzig, Union Berlin, Mainz 05, Bournemouth, Coventry City, Levante crests specifically).

Golf/tour events (TOUR Championship, Husqvarna British Masters) correctly show a flag-in-hole icon instead of a country/team crest, plus a Norwegian-player tee-time hint (e.g. 'Hovland ut 20:00') - by design, not a data glitch.
Times present and sensibly formatted (24h HH:MM); multi-day events show date ranges ('22. august–13. september') instead of a single misleading time.
375px width (hardest breakpoint): no horizontal overflow, nothing clipped at the screen edge; chevrons and (i) info icons stay fully visible on every row inspected.

The floating 'Assistent' button (bottom-trailing sparkles) rests over mid-agenda rows at 375/393px (e.g. TOUR Championship, Levante – Real Betis) and in the empty margin beside the column at 900px - both are the DESIGN.md-sanctioned floating-button idiom, not occlusion bugs. It does not cover the last agenda/news row or the footer at any width checked.
Must-see accent dots (e.g. Vålerenga – Molde) appear sparingly, a handful per day, not on every row.
Header (wordmark, date, theme toggle), day-group headings ('I DAG', 'I MORGEN', 'LØRDAG 29. AUGUST', ...), and footer all intact and aligned at all three widths.
Single quiet column, generous spacing, scannable - not a cluttered grid - at all three widths.
